notes:
New
• Smart zooms: a 100% → 110% push-in only where a moment calls for it (a reaction, disbelief, a punchline, a direct-to-camera line)
• Zooms target the right layer: the facecam when your face is the point, the gameplay when the game is
• "Look right there": the zoom pushes toward the spot that changes on screen, not just the centre
• Zoom notes: "remove this zoom", "make the zoom smaller", "zoom in more here", "zoom the facecam, not the gameplay", "keep this at 100%", "make this a 110% punch-in"
• Solis learns your style: repeated notes like "music is too loud" or "hold reactions longer" can be remembered for your next projects (you choose; manage them in Settings › Creator memory)
• Send Feedback: tell us what Solis itself should do better, right from the app

Improved
• Dead space: quiet stretches under about -40 dB are cut when nothing is happening, but whispers, reactions, comedic pauses and visible action are kept
• General notes like "too many zooms", "fewer sound effects" or "stop cutting awkward silence" now apply to the whole edit

Fixed
• Zooms no longer land on plain dialogue or on gameplay lines just because they contain a number
